   2 points: 24% stored, ((646 + 0.08 * Attack Power) * (Critical Strike chance / 100 + 1)) damage cap
   3 points: 36% stored, ((891 + 0.12 * Attack Power) * (Critical Strike chance / 100 + 1)) damage cap
   4 points: 48% stored, ((1136 + 0.16 * Attack Power) * (Critical Strike chance / 100 + 1)) damage cap
   5 points: 60% stored, ((1381 + 0.2 * Attack Power) * (Critical Strike chance / 100 + 1)) damage cap
